annotation.cut_point:
We are given that:

$$
q = 3^{19} \quad \text{and} \quad q \mod 7 = 7
$$

reflection.error_reason: The problem does not state that the divisor is 7, and a remainder modulo 7 cannot be 7; remainders modulo 7 must be between 0 and 6.
reflection.new_direction: Let the unknown divisor be d and set up the congruence 3^{19} ≡ 7 (mod d), so d divides 3^{19} - 7.
